summary: The EmailRequestContactChange module enables users to send emails to request contact changes related to a destination in HSPnet. It provides a web interface for composing the email, managing attachments, and specifying recipients, including To, Cc, Bcc fields. The system enforces validations, supports file uploads, and controls visibility and behavior depending on query parameters and user session data.
purpose: To allow users to request a contact change by sending an email containing relevant destination information, attachments, and user signature, with flexible recipient fields and robust validation and feedback mechanisms.

workflows.name: Send Email Request for Contact Change
steps: Page loads and validates URL hash.
Setup page controls based on query parameters (e.g., ShowBcc, ShowCc, ShowTo, AttachURL).
Fetches destination, staff, and service data for email fields.
Pre-fills email body, subject, and signature using templates and session data.
User enters or confirms recipient emails (To, Cc, Bcc).
User composes email body and adds signature.
User can upload attachments to be included in the email.
Validates email input: subject and body must not be empty; recipients must be valid emails.
Client-side JavaScript validates input and prevents invalid characters.
System composes email, merges additional data into the template, attaches files, and sends.
Success/failure feedback provided; errors captured and displayed.
Attachments may be deleted or added before sending.

workflows.name: Manage Attachments
steps: System creates a unique folder, saves the file, and updates attachment list.
User can delete attachments before sending.
System updates and binds attachment list on changes.

business_rules: At least one recipient (To or hidden email) must be specified.
Recipients must be valid email addresses.
Attachments must conform to upload validation rules (file type, expression).
validations: RegularExpressionValidator for email addresses and file upload.
Client-side JavaScript validation for email body and recipient fields (validEmail, hasEmails, PreventInvalidEmailCharacter).
Server-side validation for subject and body (CheckIsValid).
calculations: Dynamic generation of email subject and body using templates.
Phone and contact info formatting using NameFormatter and session/localization data.
conditions: Visibility of To, Cc, Bcc, and Attach fields controlled by query parameters (ShowTo, ShowCc, ShowBcc, ShowAttach).
Different template body if initial email body not specified.
Attachment section visible only when files are present or ShowAttach is set.
system_behavior: Auto-hide panels for errors and warnings by client actions.
Dynamically binds attachments list after changes.
Handles uploaded files by creating unique folders and saving files.
Provides localized and dynamic UI text based on resources.
Updates the UI and feedback on send or attachment events.
exceptions: No email sent if no recipients are specified (error message shown).
Error feedback if email send fails (message shown).
content_gaps: Underlying email sending infrastructure details are not included.
No explicit description of error handling for file upload failures.
No details about template file contents or localization resource strings.
